quests.title: Where's Appa?

Win a duel with Aang: Master of All Elements in your deck

endings.title: Bring Appa home
endings.about: Appa is back, and Aang isn't letting him out of his sight again.

quests.title: The Avatar State

endings.title: Reach out to Azula
endings.about: Aang offers Azula a hand. She refuses it, and her road to the throne closes for good.

endings.title: Stand against her
endings.about: Aang holds the line. Azula's road to the throne stays open.

stages.text: Win a duel against Azula with a Red deck

quests.title: Heir of Fire
quests.about: Azula's coronation is near, and the Avatar stands in her way. What she does next depends on who she trusts.

endings.title: Take the crown

endings.title: Walk away from the throne

me enters center with fade
me: The Anti-Spirals erased worlds. I saw them. I made a choice.
me: Everyone hated me for it. I let them. Hatred was easier than explaining.
player: I don't hate you.
me (intro): No. You don't. Remarkable.
me: A thousand years, and a child on the surface calls the Spiral King a friend.
choice
- You're not alone anymore.
- The surface is big enough for both of us.
me (lose): Then let the spiral turn. I will watch it with you.
them: Spiral life form. Your existence accelerates the end of the universe.
them: Why do you persist? Why do you grow? It is pointless.
them: Repetition. A spiral trait.
them (pleased): Stillness. Quiet. You understand restraint. Rare.
them (dismayed): Noise. Motion. Evolution. You test my patience.
them: Despair is the only certainty. I will demonstrate.
them (dismayed): ...Calculations incorrect. The spiral... exceeds parameters.
them (pleased): As predicted. Accept stagnation.
them: You return. Again. Your behaviour is... statistically anomalous.
them: Spiral life form designate: {player}. Tolerated. Observed. Perhaps... valued.
them: You do not despair. Analysis inconclusive.
them: We were once like you. We chose to stop. We sealed ourselves away to save the universe.
them: If all spiral life were like you... perhaps the end would not come. A dangerous hypothesis.
them: Spiral life form detected.
them: Spiral life form designate: {player}. Proceed.
them: {player}. Your presence has been... anticipated.
them: Departure noted.
them: Observation paused.
them: Return. The observation is... incomplete without you.

background void
me enters center with fade
me: Observe. The universe. Finite. Fragile.
me: Every spiral that grows draws it closer to collapse. Spiral Nemesis.
player: So you stopped everyone growing?
me: We stopped ourselves first. Then everyone else.
me: You find this cruel.
player: I find it lonely.
me (win): ...Lonely. A spiral concept. We abandoned it with our forms.
me: Return. I will observe you further. Designate: acquaintance... no. Friend.

scenes.name: World: Anti Spiral, Best friend
script: cast me as Anti Spiral
background space
me enters center with fade
me: We have watched countless spirals. They burn out.
me: You did not. You grew without destroying. You grew toward us.
player: Maybe growth doesn't have to end everything.
me (intro): A hypothesis we never permitted ourselves to test.
me: You have tested it. Result: we feel something. Designated: warmth.
choice
- That's friendship.
- Welcome back to feeling.
me (lose): Friendship. Logged. Retained. Permanently.
